info.title: API.SH: TVmaze
info.description: The TVmaze API from API.SH: public TVmaze data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
One episode by its id, by show + season + number, or by show + air date: name, season, number, type, air date, time and timestamp, runtime, rating, image and summary, with the show, the guest cast (person, character) and the guest crew. Data from TVmaze (CC BY-SA 4.0).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/tvmaze-episode

parameters.name: show
parameters.description: TVmaze show number or link (with season and number, or date).

parameters.name: number
parameters.description: Episode number in the season (with show).

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Air date YYYY-MM-DD (with show, instead of season and number).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

get.description:
A person by TVmaze id: name, country, birthday, deathday, gender, image, and their cast credits (show, character, voice role) and crew credits (show, role). Data from TVmaze (CC BY-SA 4.0): attribution to tvmaze.com is required when you republish it.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/tvmaze-person

get.description:

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/tvmaze-person-credits

parameters.name: include
parameters.description: guest (default) adds guest appearances; none leaves them out.

get.description:
A show by TVmaze id, IMDb id or TheTVDB id: name, type, language, genres, status, runtime, premiere and end dates, schedule, rating, network or streaming service, external ids, summary, every season (number, episode count, dates, network), cast with characters, crew with roles, alternative titles by country, images, and the previous and next episode. Data from TVmaze (CC BY-SA 4.0): attribution to tvmaze.com is required when you republish it.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/tvmaze-show

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: TVmaze show id (82 = Game of Thrones).

parameters.name: imdb
parameters.description: IMDb id instead of `id`, e.g. tt0944947.

get.description:
Shows or people changed in the last day, week or month, newest first: id, update time and link. Pass `next_offset` back as `offset`; null at the end. Data from TVmaze (CC BY-SA 4.0).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/tvmaze-updates

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
